name: Nathan M. Johnson
summary:
Nathan Matthew Johnson (born February 12, 1968) is an American politician, lawyer, and composer who is the attorney general-elect of Texas. A member of the Democratic Party, he has represented the 16th district in the Texas Senate since 2019.
In the November 6, 2018, election, Johnson defeated incumbent Republican Don Huffines to become the first Democrat to represent the district in over three decades.
